profile.headline: Senior Front End Engineer
profile.summary: Front end developer with a focus on developing single page applications.

positions.title: Front End Engineer II
positions.description:
* Ensured company-wide compliance with EU’s Digital Markets Act and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act for data storage by developing new internal applications as a division for an internal exabyte-scale data lake using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and internal UI frameworks, and AWS.
* Led the development of a single page application allowing dataset owners to download data schemas and apply metadata tags to consistently identify data field types for compliance with PII, HIPAA, COPPA, and other data regulations using TypeScript with React to integrate with APIs and workflow managers from multiple other teams.
* As a team, created a new single page application to allow dataset owners to define virtual views of datasets in order to restrict access for compliance purposes. The application was coded in React and TypeScript using the React Context API with React Hooks for data management.
* Maintained and improved Datacentral, an overarching single page application for data lake dataset management, by implementing microfrontend architecture to decentralize pieces from the larger SPA as well as assisting developers on other teams with implementation and integration issues in React with JavaScript and utilizing Redux to handle state management across 100+ pages.
* Assisted in multi-team effort for backend and frontend implementation of GraphQL middleware server to allow for consolidation and caching of API calls to multiple internal services using Node.js, TypeScript, Apollo.

positions.title: Front End Architect
positions.description:
* Architected front end solution for primary client to swiftly transition business model from in-person lead generation and attendance for financial planners to a fully online, virtual seminar system in spring of 2020. Responsible for rapid prototypes of various online video solutions as well as final implementation using vanilla JavaScript with Web Components.
* Increased personalized reminder calls by 300% by prototyping, designing, and implementing a custom multi-user single page application using React, Redux, socket.io, node.js, Express, MongoDB.
* Built custom SPAs for clients to handle CRM using rapid development principles. Technology stack included React/Redux, Web Components, node.js, MongoDB deployed with Docker and Kubernetes on AWS with a heavy emphasis on microservices.
* Modeled data structures for new microservices alongside the back end architect as well as establishing and maintaining API contracts using protocol buffers/gRPC.

positions.title: Senior UI/UX Developer
positions.description: Worked on proprietary internal single page applications using Angular with ngrx/store as a Redux-style data store.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Responsible for feature development on a large-scale, responsive, single-page web application using Backbone to integrate with a RESTful web services layer and accompanied by unit and integration tests.

positions.title: Tech Lead - Senior Front End Architect
positions.description: Responsible for structural front-end technical decisions on Ford brand sites (ford.com, lincoln.com) as well as prototyping of new technologies and concepts, using modern web technologies and frameworks.

positions.title: Web UI Interactive Programmer
positions.description: Worked with a team to conceptualize and develop new applications to analyze, measure, and interpret cloud computing performance. Focused on front-end development using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, as well as a variety of server languages to both build new interactive applications and improve existing apps for both the desktop and mobile web.

positions.title: Interactive Developer (Contract)
positions.description: Built new functionality and sections for corporate websites including Kimberly-Clark and Hilton Worldwide using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, ASP.NET, and C#.  Created mobile-friendly web pages and iPad applications for Specialized Bicycle Components with a focus on HTML5, touch gestures, and animations.

positions.title: Web Programmer/Developer
positions.description: Developed and co-designed an online application for end users to track various activities for personal monitoring and growth and to earn incentives from employers. Repaired issues and added functionality to existing applications using PHP, SQL, ASP. Designed and developed Flash movies both for stand-alone promotions and for integration with existing Flash-based e-learning courses.
